newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-WAINWRIGHT CAPTAINS SCOTLAND V WALES.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-WAINWRIGHT CAPTAINS SCOTLAND V WALES.

text.p: Rob Wainwright, returning from injury, was named on Tuesday to captain Scotland in their opening Five Nations championship match against Wales next Saturday.
Wainwright missed matches against Australia and Italy earlier this season because of an Achilles tendon injury.
Fly-half Craig Chalmers makes his 50th appearance for Scotland in the match at Murrayfield.

15-Rowen Shepherd; 14-Tony Stanger, 13-Scott Hastings, 12-Gregor Townsend, 11-Kenny Logan; 10-Craig Chalmers, 9-Gary Armstrong; 8-Rob Wainwright, 7-Murray Wallace, 6-Peter Walton, 5-Doddie Weir, 4-Andy Reed, 3-Matt Stewart, 2-Kevin McKenzie, 1-Dave Hilton.
